verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only touches thread-level privacy (public/private threads branching off a channel) and generic marketing language about customizing 'your own space,' with no docs on role-based channel permissions, creating private channels, or admin membership controls at the server/channel level. missing for 10: documentation on channel permission/role systems, private channel creation for admins, membership/invite controls, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of these admin features.
